The mechanism appears to involve a receptor-mediated pathway, where l-tryptophan may act as a modulator of the receptor, which in turn influences the transporter. This integrated pathway highlights the role of l-tryptophan in regulating the activity of the transporter through a receptor-mediated mechanism, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
